# AOD M3 mapping dependency

Exact unmodified files from AOD PR #43, commit `b78b48dd7aa1608dbb7141e9814e33c3cfcf900b`. The canonical marker remains v41.02. Import the module API through `matter1_m3`; do not run its repository-specific report CLI here. `binding.json` binds every imported byte and original path. Conditional mapping mathematics does not admit an atomic or isotope model.
